name: scryproof-desktop
description: Scryproof for the desktop. The client ships inside the installer, not from the server.
author: Scryproof

scripts.dist: npm run release && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never && npm run sign-installer
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/mac-preflight.mjs && npm run client && env -u APPLE_ID -u APPLE_APP_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD -u APPLE_API_KEY -u APPLE_API_KEY_ID -u APPLE_API_ISSUER APPLE_KEYCHAIN_PROFILE=scryproof-notary APPLE_TEAM_ID=LRU27MC63Q electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never && npm run notarize:mac:dmg && npm run sign-installer -- --mac
scripts.dist:mac:adhoc: npm run client && electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 --publish never --config.mac.identity=- --config.mac.notarize=false --config.mac.forceCodeSigning=false
scripts.notarize:mac:dmg: xcrun notarytool submit release/Scryproof.dmg --keychain-profile scryproof-notary --wait && xcrun stapler staple release/Scryproof.dmg

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Scryproof uses your microphone so people in your call can hear you.
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Scryproof uses your camera when you choose to share video.
